statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-1584 (GNUTLS-SA-2026-02-09-1): a TLS 1.3 resumption attempt with an invalid PSK binder value in the ClientHello could crash a GnuTLS server through a NULL pointer dereference in the pre_shared_key extension code (lib/ext/pre_shared_key.c). Upstream says GnuTLS 3.8.10 and earlier are not affected. GnuTLS fixed it in 3.8.12 with commit acf67a4a68bc6d9ab7b882469c67f6cf28db56a0: https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/commit/acf67a4a68bc6d9ab7b882469c67f6cf28db56a0, https://gnutls.org/security-new.html, https://gitlab.com/gnutls/gnutls/-/blob/3.8.14/NEWS . Alpine's 3.23-stable gnutls APKBUILD builds gnutls from the upstream release and lists CVE-2026-1584 under its 3.8.12-r0 security fixes: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/gnutls/APKBUILD . We downloaded every package built from the gnutls source in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository: gnutls, gnutls-c++, gnutls-dbg, gnutls-dev, gnutls-doc and gnutls-utils, each at 3.8.11-r0, 3.8.12-r0, 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 for x86_64 and aarch64, 48 apks, and checked each download against its index checksum; no gnutls package is published in the DHI Alpine security repository. The library code is in libgnutls.so.30 in the gnutls package; gnutls-c++ ships the C++ wrapper libgnutlsxx.so.30, the seven gnutls-utils programs list libgnutls.so.30 as a needed library, gnutls-dev ships headers, pkg-config data and the libgnutls.so and libgnutlsxx.so symbolic links and no static library, and gnutls-dbg ships debug symbols. The GnuTLS version string in libgnutls.so.30 reads 3.8.11, 3.8.12, 3.8.13 and 3.8.14 in the matching builds on both architectures. So 3.8.11-r0 is affected and 3.8.12-r0 is the first fixed build; 3.8.13-r0 and 3.8.14-r0 also carry the fix.
